title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Set up before they arrive
hook: What are your players doing while you set out the bases?
intro: You arrive right at start time.
Kids wait while you set out bases and buckets.
statement: Ten early minutes can save twenty during practice.
q1: Do you arrive early and set everything up —
q2: or let early players help you set up?
q3: What do kids do in those first minutes?
t1: Both can work. But practice starts on time
t2: when the field is ready before the kids are.
cta: Coaches — when do you set up?
ctaLines: Early alone. Kids help. Set up between drills.
Ready early or set up together?
ctaPrompt: Share your setup habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What are your players doing while you set out the bases?
You arrive right at start time. Kids wait while you set out bases and buckets.
Ten early minutes can save twenty during practice.
Set up early or set up with the kids. Every team is different.
When do you set up? Share your habit in the comments.
